messages:
ops-bot: INCIDENT DETECTED: elevated 5xx rate on /v1/generate (us-west1). Pager dispatched to #oncall and #incidents. Initial alert: p50 latency up, error-rate spike > 8% since 1932102400.

ops-bot: Pager details: severity=sev2, affected_customers=approx 12, approx_impacted_routes=[/v1/generate], suggested_runbook=runtime-rate-spike.

nina (oncall): on it. grabbing dashboard + quick impact. tagging matt & lia. anyone seeing a deploy around 1932102350?

matt (infra): I see a canary rollout to kernel-v2 that started ~1932102300 (k8s deploy id deploy-rl-2026-03-15-23). Traffic weight 10% to canary. Rolling back now to eliminate that vector.

lia (sre): copying logs for the last 10m. main symptom: KV cache evictions spiking and some OOM traces from runtime shards. Could be kernel mismatch + memory pressure on certain GPU shapes. Sharing quick grep below.

lia (sre): ```
[2026-03-15T23:01:12Z] shard-7 ERROR kv_cache: evicting prefix, used=98%
[2026-03-15T23:01:13Z] shard-7 WARN runtime: allocation failed: out-of-memory, fallback to cpu
[2026-03-15T23:01:14Z] shard-7 ERROR serve: request failed: internal-server-error
```

matt (infra): thanks. I'm rolling the canary back to kernel-v1 now: `kubectl set image deploy/rl-runtime runtime=image:kernel-v1 --namespace=redwood-prod` — deploy-bot will post status.

deploy-bot: Rollback triggered by matt. ID: rb-1932102475. Canary weight -> 0% within 45s, rollout paused.

nina (oncall): Lina, lia — can you correlate error counts by customer? need quick customer impact table for comms. emily, heads-up to CS: we may need to send a short note to impacted accounts if this doesn't improve in 15m.

emily (cs): on it. pinging top 12 impacted CSMs and drafting template. prefer brief: what we saw, what we're doing, ETA for next update.

lia (sre): quick table (errors/5m window):
- customer-a: 25 errors (20% of traffic)
- customer-b: 12 errors (5% of traffic)
- customer-c: 3 errors (7% of traffic)
others: small spike. full export to /tmp/impact-1932102480.csv.

matt (infra): core metrics look better as rollback completes — p50 latency dropping back to baseline in us-west1. Error-rate trending down from 8% -> 1.4% over last 2m. Still watching for residual evictions.

nina (oncall): good. Lia, can you run `kdump` on one of the affected pods and attach logs (root cause artifacts)? include kernel-v2 artifacts if present.

lia (sre): attached snippet from kdump: ```
--- dmesg ---
[   45.123456] Out of memory: Kill process 1122 (runtime) score 987 or sacrifice child
[   45.123457] KERNEL-VERSION: kernel-v2
[   45.123458] Alloc fail on GPU shard-7: attempted 512MB, available 64MB
```
Full artifact link: https://artifacts.internal/reports/1932102498-kdump (internal).

matt (infra): added hypothesis tag: kernel-alloc-regression. Also checking scheduling differences between kernels (nv driver incompat). Opening a short perf diff with GPU team.

henry (product): any customer-facing risk beyond transient errors? Are any SLA windows hit?

emily (cs): early list: 3 paying customers saw > 10% request failures for ~6 minutes; CS team ready to escalate if we need a post-incident note.

nina (oncall): drafting status page update (2-line) — emily pls sign off:
"We are investigating elevated errors impacting text generation in us-west1. We’ve identified a canary kernel rollout as a likely cause and have rolled back to the previous kernel. Early mitigation shows error rates returning to normal. We will provide a follow-up in 30 minutes."

emily (cs): +1. add ETA for follow-up 30m, and mention affected endpoints (/v1/generate).

lia (sre): further log correlation: only shards on machines with nv driver 525.x saw the OOMs; machines with 522.x are fine. Rolling this into hypothesis: driver+kernel interaction.

matt (infra): opening infra follow-up ticket: INF-1932102505. Assigning to kernel-oncall and gpu-team. Also snapshotting node images: `gcloud compute images describe` done.

nina (oncall): mitigation checklist: 1) rollback canary (done), 2) scale up routing capacity to avoid retries -> matt to apply, 3) set automatic fallback to CPU path for requests hitting evicted KV prefixes, 4) comms drafted and published. Any objections?

lia (sre): no objections. I'll push a temporary knob: `runtime.env.FORCE_CPU_FALLBACK=true` for affected nodes. Doing that now.

deploy-bot: Config change applied: CONFIG-1932102520. Affected pods restarting gracefully.

matt (infra): scaling routing pool +10% for 10m to smooth spikes. `autoscaler set --pool=us-west1-router --scale=+10% --duration=10m` complete.

nina (oncall): monitoring window: watching for recurrence. If errors <2% for 10m we mark mitigated and prepare RCA thread.

lia (sre): errors at 0.9% and falling. KV eviction metrics normalized. Keeping the CPU fallback env for now.

emily (cs): status page posted: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/1932102468 — short message + note that we’ve rolled back canary and investigating root cause. CS notified impacted CSMs and queued an outbound template if needed.

henry (product): request that we capture which customers hit degraded quality (not just errors) — could be retries or partial outputs. Lia/matt pls include any evidence in RCA.

lia (sre): noted, will include token-level failure patterns and model response diffs in RCA artifacts.

nina (oncall): preparing handoff to night oncall in 25m. I'll assemble timeline + artifacts for async RCA: timeline, deploy IDs, kdump, pod logs, perf diffs, customer-impact CSV, status page link.

matt (infra): created a condensed timeline here:
- 1932102300: kernel-v2 canary rollout starts (deploy-rl-2026-03-15-23)
- 1932102355: first spike in KV eviction metrics observed
- 1932102400: alert triggered (ops-bot)
- 1932102475: rollback to kernel-v1 initiated (rb-1932102475)
- 1932102520: config fallback applied (CONFIG-1932102520)
- 1932102570: error rates below 1%

nina (oncall): good. compiling into /incidents/threads/1932102468-timeline.txt and pushing artifacts to the RCA folder.

lia (sre): adding hypothesis tracker in-thread:
1) kernel-v2 introduces a regression in GPU allocator interacting with nv driver 525.x -> high KV evictions + OOMs. (LIKELY)
2) misconfiguration in canary routing sent too much stateful traffic to canary shards (POSSIBLE)
3) unrelated memory leak triggered by recent model change (UNLIKELY given timing)

nina (oncall): please add any logs to the tracker and mark evidence links. Next steps for RCA: perf diff between kernel-v1 and v2, driver compatibility matrix, reproduce on staging with driver 525.x, write postmortem with mitigation and rollout guardrails.

emily (cs): thanks — CS will prep customer notes for postmortem if customers request details.

deploy-bot: Incident marked mitigated by nina at 1932102690. Final error-rate baseline confirmed.

nina (oncall): handoff summary for night oncall (@oncall-night): Mitigated after rollback of kernel-v2 canary. Primary hypothesis: kernel+driver alloc regression. Key artifacts: kdump, pod logs, perf diff ticket INF-1932102505, impact CSV, status page link. If errors resurge, please escalate to gpu-team and kernel-oncall and re-open pager.

henry (product): thanks everyone for quick response. we'll schedule a 1hr post-incident sync tomorrow to agree on rollout guardrails (canary traffic limits, kernel-driver matrix check, automated preflight tests).

nina (oncall): creating the RCA doc and will post link in this thread. leaving handoff notes in the doc.

lia (sre): leaving a final note: keep the CPU fallback until kernel team gives a clean sign-off.

emily (cs): confirmed CS follow-up plan: outreach to impacted accounts if they ask; proactive notif if we detect any quality regressions in next 24h.

ops-bot: Incident closed: severity downgraded to sev3 at 1932102700.

nina (oncall): closing thread here — will attach RCA URL once draft is ready. Great teamwork. :thumbsup:
